config.estimator: Augmented inverse-probability weighting using logistic propensity and linear outcome regression on observed affinity and log viewing opportunity; household bootstrap for intervals.
config.sensitivity: Vary an explicitly simulated latent loyalty factor that affects both presentation assignment and later return; do not use latent or oracle fields in the estimator.
config.interpretation: Exploratory observational sensitivity demonstration only; randomized ITT remains primary and observational results cannot approve a metric or replace the target.
prohibited_changes: Do not include oracle propensity, latent loyalty, true return probability, or future return in estimator features.
Do not interpret AIPW as removing unmeasured confounding.
Do not conflate observational adjusted effects with randomized household ITT results.

observational_estimate.estimator: Augmented inverse-probability weighted (AIPW), with household bootstrap uncertainty
assumptions: Consistency and no interference between households.
Conditional exchangeability given observed affinity and log viewing opportunity; violated when the simulated latent loyalty confounder affects both assignment and return.
Positivity and adequate propensity overlap; inspect the reported common-support and effective-sample-size diagnostics.
Correct specification of either the propensity model or the outcome regression for double robustness; neither model corrects unmeasured confounding.
All registered household outcomes and measured covariates are observed; complete households are resampled for uncertainty.
observational_estimate.warning: Exploratory synthetic observational estimate; not interchangeable with randomized ITT, not evidence about real content decisions, and not approval of any proxy.
